title: aiBrowser Traffic Capture Record
description: Schema for a single HTTP request/response pair captured by aiBrowser's TrafficCapture module. Other tools (e.g. aiSSRF) can read index.jsonl and validate records against this schema.

schema_version.description: Schema version identifier — always "1.0" for this revision.

request_id.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the string '{method}:{url}:{captured_at}', serving as a deterministic unique identifier for each captured request/response pair.

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at which the response was captured.

method.description: HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, etc.).

url.description: Full absolute URL of the request.

query_params.description: Parsed query-string parameters, where each key maps to a list of values (dict[str, list[str]]). Empty object if no query string was present.

request_headers.description: Request headers as sent by the browser (dict[str, str]). Header names are in their original casing per the HTTP spec.

request_body_ref.description: Relative path to the content-addressed request body file (e.g. 'bodies/<sha256>.bin'), or null if the body was unavailable (already consumed, network error, or no body present).

request_body_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the raw request body bytes, or null if the body was unavailable.

response_status.description: HTTP response status code (e.g. 200, 404), or null if the response was never received (e.g. network error).

response_headers.description: Response headers as received (dict[str, str]). Empty object if headers could not be read.

response_body_ref.description: Relative path to the content-addressed response body file (e.g. 'bodies/<sha256>.bin'), or null if the body was unavailable (already consumed, network error).

response_body_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the raw response body bytes, or null if the body was unavailable.
